description: A threshold switch with hysteresis that analyzes an analog input value and switches a digital output accordingly. The hysteresis prevents frequent toggling when the value fluctuates around the threshold.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.description: A numeric input that provides the measured or calculated value to be compared against the configured thresholds.

outputs.name: Output
outputs.description: A boolean output that switches based on the input value and configured thresholds with hysteresis.

config.name: Hysteresis mode
config.description: Defines how the hysteresis is configured: either using a midpoint with hysteresis range, or explicit on/off thresholds.

config.name: Midpoint value
config.description: The center point of the hysteresis range. Output turns on when value exceeds midpoint + hysteresis, and turns off when value falls below midpoint - hysteresis.

config.name: Hysteresis range
config.description: The range around the midpoint that creates the hysteresis effect. Must be greater than 0. Output switches at midpoint ± hysteresis.

config.name: Value output turns on
config.description: The threshold value at which the output turns on. If value_on > value_off, output activates when value rises above this threshold. If value_on < value_off, output activates when value falls below this threshold.

config.name: Value output turns off
config.description: The threshold value at which the output turns off. If value_on > value_off, output deactivates when value falls below this threshold. If value_on < value_off, output deactivates when value rises above this threshold.
